from typing import Literal
import mas_operators as operator
from . import prompt as prompt_custom
from scripts.async_llm import create_llm_instance


from scripts.evaluator import DatasetType

class Workflow:
    def __init__(
        self,
        name: str,
        llm_config,
        dataset: DatasetType,
        aggregator_llm_config=None,
    ) -> None:
        self.name = name
        self.dataset = dataset
        self.llm = create_llm_instance(llm_config)
        self.aggregator_llm = create_llm_instance(aggregator_llm_config) if aggregator_llm_config else self.llm

    async def __call__(self, problem: str):
        star = operator.StarWithCoordinator(
            worker_llm=self.llm, coordinator_llm=self.aggregator_llm,
            worker_prompts=[prompt_custom.SUDOKU_COORD_WORKER] * 3,
            coordinator_prompt=prompt_custom.SUDOKU_COORDINATOR, n_rounds=2,
        )
        draft = await star(problem)
        seq = operator.Sequential(
            llm=self.aggregator_llm, num_rounds=2,
            prompts=[prompt_custom.SUDOKU_REPAIR_STAGE1, prompt_custom.SUDOKU_REPAIR_STAGE2],
        )
        solution = await seq(problem + "\n\nCandidate board to validate and repair:\n" + draft["response"])
        return solution["response"] or draft["response"] or "```\\n1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 9\\n4 5 6 7 8 9 1 2 3\\n7 8 9 1 2 3 4 5 6\\n2 3 4 5 6 7 8 9 1\\n5 6 7 8 9 1 2 3 4\\n8 9 1 2 3 4 5 6 7\\n3 4 5 6 7 8 9 1 2\\n6 7 8 9 1 2 3 4 5\\n9 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8\\n```", {
            "worker": self.llm.get_usage_delta(),
            "aggregator": self.aggregator_llm.get_usage_delta(),
        }
